scope: Offline isolated semantic parsing; no production integration or model calls
comparison: Ignore evidence and condition IDs, preserve Boolean tree scope, modality, exact values, edit target IDs and operation order. Only consecutive additions commute. Separately report resulting-plan equality. No post-outcome Boolean rewrites.
sourceCoverage: Every non-whitespace character must have an ownership span except ordinary punctuation . , ; ! ? apostrophes quotes parentheses colon. Ignored numbers, operators, currency symbols and other material characters invalidate acceptance.
chains: Supply actual preceding accepted state; refusal preserves actual previous state. Never substitute gold state. Report direct failures and subsequent chain failures separately.
freeze: Seal all runtime/scoring/policy sources and independently reviewed corpus before parsing. One corpus pass, no tuning against held-out results. Keep every raw result and pre-call corpus revision.
goldProvenance: Independent agent-authored and agent-reviewed constructed bilingual gold, not external human annotation; paired translations are correlated and do not establish population accuracy.
exposureLimitation: The parent reviewed benchmark labels before the structural grammar rewrite. The original implementation worker was blinded; the final parent implementation was not completely blinded. This frozen benchmark is diagnostic, not an independent certification of generalization.
